items.text:
Shift Up’s first console publishing project has been successfully launched. I would like to extend my heartfelt gratitude to all the fans who have always believed in us, supported us, and patiently waited. My deepest thanks also go out all the Shift Up staff whose hard work made this challenge a reality. 

I hope you all thoroughly enjoy both the Stellar Blade Nintendo Switch 2 and the newly added Bayonetta collaboration content. Thank you!

P.S. A big congratulations on the release of ‘The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time’ as well! It is a great honor to launch on the very same day as such a masterpiece, and as a fan myself, I cannot wait to play it. Though... I'll have to play it right after I finish Stellar Blade on Nintendo Switch 2 🤭
#StellarBlade #StellarBladeNS2
items.text_zh:
Shift Up 的首个主机发行项目已成功上线。我衷心感谢所有始终相信我们、支持我们并耐心等待的粉丝们。我也向所有辛勤付出、让这一挑战成为现实的 Shift Up 员工致以最深切的感谢。

希望大家尽情享受《剑星》Nintendo Switch 2 版以及新增的猎天使魔女联动内容。谢谢！

附言：热烈祝贺《The Lege》发售
